entries.unchanged_closure_criteria: Record positive and negative handshake exchanges with exact byte consumption, response status, pipelining behaviour and closure order.
entries.review: Ordinary primary-control boundaries are exercised with exact host/guest TCP bytes, five3-second split windows, short half-close, pipelined/frame-prefix preservation and explicit guest reset/FIN ordering. Alternate-wrapper negotiations, matched-reference transfer streams, timers and historical peers remain separately tracked.
